b75b659bc851d817.description: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com. Role Summary And Impact The Media Executive supports the development and execution of media plans and campaigns, ensuring efficient implementation of media strategies to meet campaign objectives and client needs, ultimately contributing to the success of client campaigns and the growth of the agency. Assist in the creation and execution of media plans, including the scheduling and placement of ads across various channels. Coordinate with media vendors and ensure timely delivery of media assets and placements. Monitor and manage media campaigns to ensure adherence to schedules and budgets. Support the negotiation of media rates and placements with vendors, ensuring favorable terms for the agency or client. Maintain relationships with media vendors and assist in sourcing new opportunities and securing media buys. Collect and analyze media performance data, providing insights and recommendations for campaign optimization. Prepare regular reports on media activities, including budget tracking, performance metrics, and campaign results. Monitor ongoing campaigns and adjust strategies as needed to improve performance and achieve campaign goals. Act as a point of reference for clients and internal teams regarding media planning and execution. Manage media schedules, trafficking of ads, and ensure all media materials are delivered accurately and on time. Skills And Experience At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values: Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Saudi national Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Advertising, Media, or a related field. Strong interest in the media landscape and a desire to learn about media planning and buying. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). Life At WPP Media & Benefits Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please read our Privacy Notice ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide. While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

b703cf5039d38b4f.description: Additional Information Job Number 26134554 Job Category Housekeeping & Laundry Location Ummahat Islands 2-3, Red Sea, Saudi ArabiaVIEW ON MAP Schedule Full Time Located Remotely? N Position Type Non-Management Position Summary Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience. No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time. At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law. At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate. Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests. Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with. In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

b71b605ff40291f7.description: About the Role Capgemini is seeking an MCX Solution Architect to define and lead the end-to-end design and deployment of mission-critical communication platforms. This permanent position is based in Riyadh and focuses on enterprise and industrial environments. The role ensures high availability, low latency, and secure interoperability across various systems for global clients. Key Responsibilities Architecting Mission Critical Services solutions (MCPTT/MCVideo/MCData), including QoS, priority and preemption, group communications, and service continuity across complex environments. Leading end-to-end solution blueprints spanning access network, transport, core, IMS/application layer, dispatch and recording systems, device ecosystems, and integration interfaces. Driving vendor selection, solution validation, and deployment governance, including HLD/LLD documentation, integration planning, cutover strategies, and acceptance testing. Defining resilience architecture encompassing geo-redundancy, active-active/active-standby configurations, disaster recovery strategy, backup and restore, and observability frameworks. Establishing security-by-design principles and compliance guardrails for MCX services, covering encryption, identity management, key management, and auditability. Supporting the test team through ATP phases, defect qualification, and FAT/SAT readiness activities. Leading technical workshops with key stakeholders, translating complex operational requirements into technical designs and structured delivery backlogs. Required Experience Candidates should possess more than 10 years of experience in a relevant field, demonstrating a strong background in solution architecture for mission-critical communication platforms. Location and Work Type This is a permanent position based in Riyadh. The role involves working with global clients on next-generation connectivity solutions.

b74855723406e81b.description: About the Role Nutreco is seeking a Key Account Manager – Livestock to join Trouw Nutrition. This full-time role involves leveraging commercial expertise and strong technical livestock knowledge to build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers. The Key Account Manager will work with strategic customers to understand their needs, translate animal nutrition solutions into measurable value, and strengthen Nutreco's market presence across Saudi Arabia. Company Overview Nutreco is part of the SHV family, a diverse group of companies with a global footprint. As a member of Nutreco, employees gain access to a wide network of expertise and global career paths, supported by a privately owned business with a long-term focus. Key Responsibilities Manage and grow key livestock and ruminant accounts throughout Saudi Arabia. Build trusted relationships with customers, technical experts, and key opinion leaders. Understand customer challenges and translate solutions into clear commercial value. Protect and grow existing business in calf milk replacers and feed additives. Develop account plans and manage opportunities, pricing, negotiations, and forecasts. Collaborate with regional technical and product marketing specialists to support key accounts across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC). Qualifications and Experience A relevant degree in Veterinary Medicine, Animal Science, Animal Nutrition, Agriculture, or a related field. Proven B2B sales or key account management experience in animal nutrition, feed additives, animal health, or feed. Experience managing large or strategic customer accounts and complex commercial negotiations. Strong knowledge of ruminant nutrition and production, particularly dairy cattle. Confidence in engaging with farm managers, veterinarians, nutritionists, and other technical specialists. A strong network among major livestock or ruminant customers in Saudi Arabia. Experience working with customers in the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman, or Bahrain is an advantage. Required Skills Fluent English with strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Arabic proficiency is strongly preferred. Willingness to travel approximately 40% within Saudi Arabia and occasionally across the GCC.

b748eb3720480a01.description: About the Role Virtucruit is collaborating with a prominent mining company in Saudi Arabia to recruit an EI & C Technician for the Maintenance Department. This full-time position is based in Najran and involves performing essential electrical, instrumentation, and control maintenance within a mining environment. The primary objective is to ensure the safe and reliable operation of all machinery and equipment. Role Overview The EI & C Technician will be responsible for conducting both preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairing equipment. This role also includes calibrating instruments and actively supporting local workforce development through mentorship and coaching initiatives. Adherence to company policies regarding personnel, safety, health, environmental protection, security, and cost reduction programs is essential. Key Responsibilities Perform daily routine and preventive maintenance activities. Execute non-routine project and upgrade work. Conduct inspections on electrical equipment and facilities. Assess work request jobs originating from other departments. Work with single and three-phase equipment. Install and troubleshoot motor control systems, including Direct Online, Forward-Reverse, and Star-Delta configurations. Assist superiors in preparing inventory lists for electrical equipment and spare parts. Read and interpret electrical diagrams. Install specified electrical equipment and devices. Test and evaluate newly installed and existing electrical equipment for abnormalities, performing necessary corrections. Repair and recondition defective electrical equipment. Check, repair, and replace defective pull cord switches, belt drift switches, and underspeed sensors for conveyor interlocks. Perform weekly tasks such as checking equipment, instruments, pneumatic gates, and valves. Conduct weekly checks and maintenance for water treatment plant components, including water pumps, dosing pumps, pneumatic valves, and variable speed drives. Verify the functionality of conveyor belt parameters, including pull cord switches, belt drift switches, and underspeed sensors. Diagnose alarms and faults in PLCs through their digital and analog I/Os. Recondition slip rings and adjust brush settings for mill drive motors in case of flashover. Check, repair, and replace defective parts of carbon regeneration kilns, elution burners, and drying ovens. Prepare and submit accomplishment reports. Attend departmental meetings and pep talks. Perform other related functions as assigned by a superior. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Associate Degree in Electrical/Instrumentation or equivalent. A minimum of 5-10 years of Electrical and Instrumentation experience in the mining or a related industry. Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral. Ability to read and understand P&ID drawings, schematic drawings, control loop drawings, logic diagrams, and ladder diagrams is an advantage. Working knowledge of PLC, DCS, and their supporting HMIs is an advantage. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply.

b78ab47893b6dd78.description: Finance & Treasury Support day-to-day finance operations and ensure smooth financial processes. Assist in cash flow planning, forecasting and management. Manage payment and receipt cycles, controls and process improvements. Support surplus cash management and bank borrowing activities. Ensure compliance with banking terms, conditions and covenants. Monitor and control costs and expenses. Support loan documentation and execution. Accounting & Compliance Supervise and support the accounting function. Ensure appropriate accounting policies, procedures and internal controls. Ensure timely accounting closure, reconciliations and financial reporting. Prepare financial information and reports for management, board and banking requirements. Coordinate annual audits and support internal audit requirements. Ensure timely filing of Zakat and VAT returns and support related compliance matters. MIS & Risk Management: Develop and maintain MIS databases and reporting systems. Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual MIS reports, along with ad-hoc management reports. Support budgeting, budget vs. actual analysis and cash flow projections. Develop and maintain risk management and compliance dashboards/reports. Investment & Legal Back Office: Support the review and execution of investment-related documents, including subscription, redemption, legal agreements, side letters and addendums. Manage the investment and disinvestment lifecycle in coordination with the investment team. Coordinate and support various legal and investment-related matters. Technology & Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve finance and accounting processes. Support effective implementation and usage of relevant ERP, financial and reporting tools. Desired Candidate Profile Qualification & Experience: Fully qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) is Mandatory. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Finance, Accounting, MIS or a similar role. Experience in a mid-size to large professionally managed organization preferred. Strong knowledge of financial accounting, MIS, budgeting, cash flow management and financial reporting. Exposure to Zakat and VAT is preferred. Excellent proficiency in MS Excel, spreadsheets and databases. ERP exposure such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business Central or eFront will be an added advantage. Strong leadership, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills. Self-starter with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Preferred Candidate: CA professionals with strong exposure to Finance, Accounting, MIS, Cash Flow, Budgeting, Banking, Compliance and Investment Back Office functions.

b78d5e2df1fb5b6f.description: About Alsalam Aerospace Industries Established in 1988, Alsalam Aerospace Industries plays a key role in Saudi Arabia's strategy to achieve self-sufficiency in civil and military aircraft maintenance, overhaul, and modifications. This is accomplished through technology transfer and the development of Saudi national talent. The company's vision is to lead the future of aviation, space, and defense, setting global standards while supporting the ambitions of Vision 2030. Its mission is to deliver high-quality aviation products and services that ensure exceptional customer satisfaction and long-term profitability. The Role of Rescue Instructor Alsalam Aerospace Industries is seeking a Rescue Instructor to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is critical for delivering high-quality training to rescue specialists, ensuring operational readiness, and maintaining stringent standards for rescue and hoist operations. The role involves both theoretical and practical instruction, development of training materials, and adherence to applicable aviation and operational standards. Key Responsibilities Report to the General Directorate of Operations and work under the organization's management. Conduct training as a Rescue Specialist Instructor on helicopter operations, adhering to approved training syllabi. This includes basic and advanced courses such as Initial Rescue Specialist, Instructor Training, Live Hoist, and other relevant rescue operations. Develop, review, and update training materials in line with operational and training requirements. Advise operational leadership on aircrew and rescue specialist training needs. Develop and maintain training materials, publications, syllabi, examinations, and related instructional documents specifically for helicopter rescue operations. Review and update training publications and materials as necessary. Maintain, update, and follow up on training records and files for rescue specialists assigned to helicopter operations. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess between 5 to 10 years of relevant experience. The position requires a strong background in rescue operations and instructional delivery, ensuring the ability to effectively train specialists to high standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within an established aerospace industry leader committed to national development and operational excellence.

b78eb89e2b35ee31.description: About the Role Haji Husein Alireza & Co. Ltd. is seeking a Counter Salesman - Workshop to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time role involves managing internal parts requisitions and ensuring the timely and accurate issuance of parts to the workshop, along with daily reconciliation and coordination with stock control. Key Responsibilities Process internal parts requisitions from workshop technicians, service advisors, and team leaders. Identify and issue correct MAN genuine spare parts using electronic parts catalogues and job card references. Ensure timely parts issuance to workshop bays, prioritizing urgent repair jobs. Coordinate with the warehouse team to locate, pick, and deliver requested parts to minimize technician waiting time. Accurately record all internal parts issuances against job cards in the parts management system. Ensure correct cost allocation and maintain traceability for warranty and billing purposes. Coordinate with the Stock Controlling & Ordering Officer to flag parts shortages impacting active workshop jobs. Escalate emergency order requirements for critical repair parts. Conduct daily reconciliation of parts issued against job cards closed. Investigate discrepancies and process returns for unused parts back to stock in a timely manner. Required Experience Candidates for this position should have 0-1 years of relevant experience. The role requires attention to detail and effective coordination skills within a workshop environment. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, focusing on supporting workshop operations through efficient parts management and supply.

b78f58a594a6991e.description: About Ma'aden Ma'aden, established in 1997, is recognized as one of the fastest-growing mining companies globally and the largest multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. The company is instrumental in developing the mining industry to become a key economic pillar for Saudi Arabia, focusing on building a fully integrated mining value chain. This role contributes to Ma'aden's growth objectives in Riyadh. Role Summary The Lead Specialist, Category (Facility Management) is responsible for developing and executing category strategies to ensure safe, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective facility services across Ma'aden's operations. This full-time role involves translating business requirements into effective sourcing and contracting solutions, enhancing supplier performance, supporting local content and sustainability goals, and maintaining service continuity for critical workplaces and operating sites. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain Facility Management category strategies aligned with business requirements, demand plans, and corporate procurement objectives. Lead end-to-end sourcing for integrated and specialized facility services, including hard services, soft services, maintenance, cleaning, catering, landscaping, pest control, waste management, and related workplace services. Conduct market analysis, supplier benchmarking, demand analysis, and cost modeling to identify opportunities for cost optimization, service improvement, consolidation, and innovation. Define sourcing plans, statements of work, service specifications, commercial evaluation models, negotiation strategies, award recommendations, and contract documentation in line with procurement governance. Negotiate pricing, service levels, performance mechanisms, contract terms, amendments, and change orders to optimize total cost and mitigate commercial, operational, compliance, and continuity risks. Partner with business units, site services, HSE, finance, legal, local content, and other stakeholders to validate requirements and implement sourcing decisions. Monitor supplier and contract performance against KPIs, SLAs, statutory requirements, HSE standards, and corrective-action plans. Embed local content, sustainability, energy efficiency, digitalization, and continuous-improvement criteria into tenders and supplier performance reviews. Maintain accurate sourcing records, savings tracking, risk registers, supplier performance data, and audit-ready documentation. Desired Outcomes Facility Management contracts are implemented on schedule, delivering measurable cost optimization, value, and service reliability. Facilities remain safe, compliant, operational, and fit for purpose through clearly defined scopes, performance standards, and supplier accountability. Service continuity and supplier risks are identified early and mitigated through effective contracting, contingency planning, and performance management. Stakeholders maintain clear alignment throughout sourcing, mobilization, transition, and contract-management activities. Supplier performance, local content contribution, sustainability outcomes, and improvement actions are tracked and reported through reliable governance. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in category management, particularly within facility management services. The role requires a strong understanding of procurement governance and strategic sourcing processes.

b7aa6c3b64f174dd.description: About Richemont Richemont is a global leader in the luxury sector, comprising various Houses specializing in jewelry, watches, and high-end accessories. Each Maison upholds a tradition of style, quality, and craftsmanship. Richemont is dedicated to preserving their unique heritage and identity while innovating and designing new products aligned with the Houses' values through continuous creativity. The Role of Senior Client Advisor Richemont is seeking a Senior Client Advisor for a full-time position in Jeddah. This role involves developing and maintaining strong client relationships, managing sales processes, and ensuring high standards of customer service. The Senior Client Advisor acts as a primary point of contact for clients, addressing inquiries and facilitating sales campaigns. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a customer contact plan to announce product launches and engage potential customers in sales campaigns, fostering new relationships. Serve as the initial point of contact for customer inquiries and complaints, resolving issues and escalating complex matters while ensuring appropriate customer responses. Establish clear objectives for each sales interaction, utilize standard presentation materials, and ask relevant questions to assess customer interest and identify areas for further information. Identify prospective customers through referrals from existing clients and contacts, or by participating in trade shows and conferences. Recommend products or services that align with customer needs, propose quantities and configurations based on expertise, explain selections, and invite purchases under standard terms. Schedule follow-up actions and input relevant information into the CRM system after each customer contact to support call planning and ensure data quality for retention and business development. Contribute to internal communications and collaborate with colleagues to build external customer relationships and meet client needs. Maintain knowledge of organizational policies, procedures, and relevant regulatory codes to ensure compliance. Obtain authorization for any exceptions from mandatory procedures. Address personal objectives and utilize performance management systems to enhance individual performance. Engage in assessment and development activities, including formal and informal training and coaching, to develop capabilities. Maintain understanding of relevant technology, external regulations, and industry best practices through ongoing education. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, where the Senior Client Advisor will contribute to a team focused on delivering exceptional service and building lasting client relationships within the luxury sector.

b7b482589ac731c1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة الخليج للموارد البشرية عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المالية اللازمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد التقارير المالية. القدرة على تدقيق الحسابات وإجراء التسويات البنكية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق متخصص، وستتاح له الفرصة لتطبيق وتطوير مهاراته في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة صفوة الخليج للموارد البشرية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الفرصة في الدمام. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

b7b87646db9ab02e.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Planning Engineer to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience and involves developing, monitoring, and reporting on project schedules and progress for various engineering, procurement, and construction activities. Key Responsibilities in Planning and Scheduling Develop, maintain, and update detailed EPC project schedules using Primavera P6. Prepare and manage baseline schedules, recovery schedules, and look-ahead plans. Monitor project progress against approved schedules and highlight deviations. Perform critical path analysis and recommend corrective actions to mitigate delays. Forecast project completion dates and support project management in schedule decision-making. Progress Monitoring and Reporting Monitor engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning activities. Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports for management and client submissions. Develop project dashboards, progress measurement systems, S-curves, and resource histograms. Track productivity, resource utilization, and key project performance indicators (KPIs). Maintain project planning records and reporting documentation. Procurement and Manufacturing Coordination Monitor material procurement, manufacturing, inspection, shipment, and site delivery milestones. Forecast material requirements and coordinate manufacturing clearances in line with project schedules. Track vendor and subcontractor deliverables against contractual milestones. Support timely mobilization of suppliers and subcontractors. Project Controls and Commercial Support Prepare cost summaries and mobilization estimates based on received quotations. Develop techno-commercial reports to monitor project financial performance and overall project health. Assist in cash flow forecasting, cost-to-complete monitoring, and project performance analysis. Support change management, delay analysis, and Extension of Time (EOT) evaluations when required. Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, QA/QC, HSE, and commercial teams for schedule updates. Participate in progress review meetings with SEC, National Grid, subcontractors, and project stakeholders. Support project management in identifying risks and implementing mitigation measures.

b7cc81bd479fe31a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة واختبار الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات. دراسة المخططات الفنية لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين المشاركين في تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. إجراء اختبارات شاملة للأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات. تنفيذ عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات كفني أجهزة إلكترونية أو في مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ الدوائر الإلكترونية والمعدات. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التركيب والصيانة واستكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها للأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الفني. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل لضمان جودة التركيب والصيانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات في جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستتاح الفرصة للعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تدعم التطوير المهني. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

b7fb25b7d99c0d18.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة لاند مارك العربية سنتربوينت عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة للعملاء من خلال بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. المسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات شاملة ودقيقة تتعلق بالمنتجات، استخداماتها، وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بشكل دوري والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات بما يتوافق مع السياسات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب العمل التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة مهام المتجر اليومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

b73c371454487f72.description: About Midana Exploration Company Midana Exploration Company (MEC) is a resource exploration and development firm and a subsidiary of Hancock Prospecting, a leading private mining enterprise based in Australia. Operating within the Middle East's expanding mining sector, MEC focuses on developing the mineral potential of the Arabian-Nubian Shield. The company aims to transition high-potential exploration targets into operational mining assets by leveraging Hancock Prospecting's experience in exploration, project delivery, technology, and operational excellence, combined with local partnerships in Saudi Arabia. Role Overview: Senior Geologist, Generative Exploration The Senior Geologist, Generative Exploration, will lead prospect and campaign-scale generative exploration work packages. This full-time role involves converting regional concepts, prospectivity outputs, and field evidence into ranked, testable, and drill-ready targets. The position is based in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah and Makkah cities, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The successful candidate will maintain high standards of safety, data quality, and geological interpretation throughout all activities. Key Responsibilities Plan and lead prospect-scale mapping, sampling, prospecting, trenching, and first-pass drilling/target testing within approved Generative Exploration programs. Convert regional geological concepts and prospectivity outputs into explicit target hypotheses, field tests, decision criteria, and ranked follow-up recommendations. Plan and supervise integrated field activities using geological mapping, geochemistry, geophysics, and drilling to generate and assess exploration targets. Integrate field observations with geology, structure, geochemistry, geophysics, remote sensing, and historical data to build defensible regional-, camp-, and target-scale interpretations. Develop robust target models covering lithology, stratigraphy, structure, alteration, and mineralisation, updating ranking as new evidence is acquired. Utilise GIS, 3D modelling, and predictive-targeting/prospectivity tools to identify gaps, test alternative interpretations, and define high-value next field actions. Lead assigned geologists and field crews, ensuring safe, disciplined, and productive execution, complete field records, and reliable sample chain-of-custody. Apply sampling and QA/QC standards, validate field and laboratory data, and promptly escalate material geological, HSE, access, or data-quality risks. Prepare target sheets, maps, sections, concise technical reports, and campaign recommendations, and coach junior geologists in mapping, targeting, logging, and data-management practices. Work Environment and Location This is a field-based role requiring extended camp rotations during active Generative Exploration campaigns. Regular travel within KSA is expected, necessitating remote-conditions capability and practical 4WD/off-road awareness. Flexibility may be required as Midana’s KSA exploration portfolio develops and expands.

b73792273209dd7e.description: About the Role Dar Al Riyadh Consultants is seeking a Senior Contracts Manager to lead the contract management process from initial negotiations through to final closeout. Key Responsibilities Prepare, review, and manage contracts, agreements, and amendments for construction supervision projects. Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and legal requirements, identifying and mitigating contractual risks. Collaborate with legal teams to resolve disputes and ensure project continuity. Monitor project budgets and costs in relation to contracts, ensuring financial targets and timelines are met. Maintain strong relationships with clients, contractors, and stakeholders, acting as the main point of contact for contractual matters. Lead negotiations with contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers, developing procurement strategies and evaluating bids. Ensure proper documentation of contracts, change orders, variations, and extensions, maintaining accurate records. Required Skills Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
